_note: Who answers and who validates unit work (C-07, C-25; technical-architecture 16.5). Roles are the stored values: product_manager is shown as Unit manager, design_engineer as Unit designer / engineer. Technical items are the matcher's product categories (technical, compliance) and go to the unit's designers / engineers. Routing decided 16 Oct 2026 (open question 2 of changes-iteration3.md): only high-level, consolidated non-technical requirements stay on the bid desk (here: submission and legal, answered once for the whole bid); the non-technical categories in unit_manager_categories go to every participating unit's manager. Changing the sequence is a change to this file, not to code. Validation (decided 19 Oct 2026): the unit manager validates the unit's technical answers; the bid manager validates non-technical unit answers, which the unit manager gives, so no unit person validates their own answer. Exception: the bid desk's own items (BID: submission and legal items answered once for the whole bid, and recorded capability gaps) are answered and validated by the bid manager, as the bid desk has no second role; they are the bid manager's statements for the bid. Technical matches (C-41, P-44): accepted, rejected or corrected by the designer / engineer of a matched unit (matching.may_change); the bid manager routes requirements, the unit only.
